android.desc:
Tap to release, time your catch, chain combos. STARFLING is a free one-tap arcade game where you sling a ball between stars in the cold dark of space. Easy to learn. Impossible to master.

THE GAME

The ball orbits a star. Tap to release it. Time your second tap to catch the next star. Chain catches quickly to build combos and rack up points. Miss a star and the run is over. Sessions last 30 to 90 seconds, making it perfect for a quick arcade break or a long session chasing a new high score.

This is hyper-casual gaming for people who actually like games. No energy meters. No pay-to-win. No manipulative ads. Just one tap and you're playing.

DAILY LEADERBOARDS

A new global leaderboard goes live every 24 hours. Beat yesterday's top scores or set a new daily record. Build a daily ritual the way you would with Wordle, but for arcade gameplay.

GENERATIVE TRAIL ART

Every run draws a unique piece of art from your path through space. The colors shift with your combo timing. The shape comes from how you played. Save your best trails or share them with friends. No two runs ever look the same.

OFFLINE FRIENDLY

Plays anywhere with no internet. Subway, plane, parking lot, anywhere. Quick load times. Small download. Runs smooth on older devices.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

Featured on Hacker News with over 600 upvotes. Built a community of players who keep coming back for the daily leaderboard reset.

FEATURES

- Free to play forever
- Optional $2.99 remove ads (one-time, no subscription)
- Watch a rewarded ad to revive a run you don't want to lose
- Daily leaderboards reset every 24 hours
- Generative trail art on every run
- Personal stats tracking (total games, stars caught, daily best, all-time high)
- Synthesized audio and haptic feedback
- Sound and haptics toggleable
- Offline play supported
- No accounts, no signups, no logins
- Minimalist dark space aesthetic
- Small download size
- Privacy respecting

PERFECT IF YOU LIKED

Flappy Bird, Helix Jump, Color Switch, Crossy Road, Stack, Rolly Vortex, Ballz, or any classic one-tap arcade game. If you want a casual game free of dark patterns, STARFLING is for you. Great as a stress relief game, a brain training break, or just something to play during your commute.

GENRES

One-tap arcade, hyper-casual, endless runner, skill game, casual game, space game, arcade game, free arcade.
